name: Policy Doctor
description:
Policy Doctor brings EU legislative, case law and lobbying intelligence directly into Claude and your daily work.
•	Monitor and analyse EU lobbying activity — search meetings, track who lobbies whom and on what topics – and what public affairs firms are used by companies
•	Profile lobbying organisations and targets like EU officials across the EU Transparency Register
•	Also includes Finnish legislative projects and lobbying information
•	Structured data designed for AI agents — retrieve, analyse, and act on policy intelligence without leaving your AI tool
•	Draft documents and infuse your own Sharepoint, Google Drive, or other files with data brought to you by Policy Doctor

Built for public affairs and legal professionals operating at the EU and national level

_published_faq.name: How do I add Policy Doctor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Policy Doctor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.policydoctor.eu/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Policy Doctor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Policy Doctor lists 39 MCP tools, including eu_get_meeting, eu_get_organization, eu_get_organization_overview, eu_get_organization_relationships, eu_get_organization_subjects, eu_get_organization_targets, eu_get_target, eu_get_target_lobbyists, eu_gov_get_procedure, eu_gov_get_procedure_documents, eu_gov_get_procedure_events, and eu_gov_search_active_procedures.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Policy Doctor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Policy Doctor in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CiteLaw.

_published_faq.name: Does Policy Doctor MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Policy Doctor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Policy Doctor is developed by Politiikkatohtori Ltd. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
